name: War Shadow (Warmage Archetype)
body:
War shadows eschew more of the actively violent spells to use the power of the shadow plane to the battlefield.

Shadow Magics (Ex)

A war shadow adds all spells with the shadow or darkness descriptors, and illusion (shadow) spells to their spell list but loses access to evocation spells. This ability modifies spells.

Arcane Strategies (Ex)

A war shadow gains access to the following arcane strategies:

Battle Magics (Ex)

You add an evocation spell available to the wizard spell to each spell level you possess or later gain, including cantrips, of your spell list. The spell must still be learned and added to your spellbook before it can be used. This arcane strategy can be selected multiple times, granting new spells for each level.

Darksight (Su)

You gain the see in darkness universal monster ability.

Resilient Shadows (Su)

You can bolster your shadow spells. Anytime a creature makes a saving throw against one of your shadow- or darkness-descriptor spells, you instead make a caster level check. Treat the DC as the result of the caster level check. Once a creature has been affected by this ability, they are immune to its effects for 24 hours.

Shadow Walk (Su)

As a swift action, you can teleport to a nearby space as if using dimension door. Both the beginning and ending spots must be in dim light or darker. This movement does not provoke an attack of opportunity. You must be able to see the space that you are moving into. You cannot take other creatures with you when you use this ability (except for familiars, if applicable). You can move 5 feet for every warmage levels you possess (minimum 5 feet). You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Intelligence modifier. This arcane strategy can be selected multiple times, granting 3 additional uses per day.

Shadowy Realism (Su)

Any spell that has the shadow descriptor and a % of effectiveness adds 1/2 your class level to the effect to a maximum of 100%.

Shield of Shadow (Sp)

At 6th level, a war shadow can conjure a shadowy disk to protect them as a standard action. This acts as the shield spell except it also provides 20% concealment. This shield remains for a number of rounds per day equal to their class level plus their Intelligence modifier, and can be dismissed as a free action. The rounds need not be used consecutively.

Creatures with darkvision ignore this concealment.

At 10th level, the shield provides total concealment to those more than 10 feet away from the war shadow.

Those within 10 feet still suffer from concealment when targeting the war shadow. Now only creatures with the see in darkness ability can ignore the concealment.

At 14th level, the AC bonus provided by the shield doubles and the war shadow gains a spell resistance of 10 plus their class level.

At 18th level, the concealment applies even if the attackers have see in darkness.

This ability replaces sudden empower, sudden enlarge, sudden widen, and sudden maximize.

Shadow Double (Sp)

At 20th level, once per day a war shadow can create a shadowy double of themselves as a standard action. The double has the base ability scores, AC, hit points, saves, and attack bonuses of their creator but with no equipment. The double appears to have the equipment but they have no effect.

The double can attack if given a weapon or use items given to them. They are treated as having the creator’s classes and abilities for item prerequisites. They can also act as the origin of the war shadow’s spells when within line of sight. Mentally commanding this double is a free action.

If the double or the war shadow are shifted to another plane, or the war shadow is rendered unconscious, the double dissipates. Otherwise, the shadow double lasts for a number of rounds equal to the war shadow’s class level.

This ability replaces war incarnate.
